messages.subject: INLA-methods papers
parts:
I do not do this, normally, but we have been pushing using
inla.mode="experimental" for some time in this list and at the help@...,
as it solves many practical issues. And we have done that without
explaining what it does. Well, finally its here, and the series of
papers

https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.12945
https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.06797
https://arxiv.org/abs/2204.04678

describe this. #1 is the method behind correcting the mean using VB, #2
is about the new internal representation (which only make sense due to
#1, wheras #3 is about parallelisation strategies used.

Best
Håvard
